usedFor: GitLab holds your merge requests, and Notion tracks them as database items through “Create_Data_Source_Item” after “New Project Merge Request Event”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project Merge Request Event” in GitLab, then “Create_Data_Source_Item” in Notion
bestTemplate.why: Each merge request lands as a Notion database item, giving non-developers a view of review work.

watchOut: “New Project Merge Request Event” fires on open, merge and close, so one request can create three items.
